transformation: Bundle each source table's Hf(298.15 K), H(T)-H(298.15 K), and S(T) columns for the printed liquid segment. Runtime apparent G(T) = 1000*(Hf(298.15 K) + Hinc) - T*S; interpolate Hinc and S linearly and take Cp from the Hinc secant. Opening and cap transition rows retain their liquid-side source values.
phase_restriction_rule: Use the stable liquid-opening transition or the first printed node in a dedicated liquid table through the printed liquid-to-gas row, inclusive, or the last printed node when no gas cap is present. Never continue outside this interval.
